Specification: The platform must run in a web browser from a public URL, with no installation, and accept any soil profile and footing that a user enters. Values for this site must not be hard-coded, because the instructor will test the platform with unseen data. You may use any technology stack, for example Python with Streamlit or Dash, or HTML and JavaScript. Use SI units throughout (kN, kPa, m, mm). Show the unit of every input and output beside it.

Accept a layered profile (depths, soil type, moist and saturated unit weights, strength, stiffness and consolidation parameters), a measured water table and a separate design water table; draw the profile
Apply the IS 2131 corrections to SPT N (overburden; dilatancy where it applies), showing each step; fit c' and phi' to direct shear data by least squares

IS 6403:1981: net ultimate and net safe bearing capacity for strip, square, rectangular and circular footings; general and local shear; shape, depth and inclination factors; water-table factor W'; effective area for eccentric loads. Every factor must be displayed
Boussinesq vertical stress increase below the centre and the corner of a uniformly loaded rectangle (by superposition), and the 2:1 method; plot delta_sigma_z against depth

Settlement of granular layers by the strain influence factor method (Schmertmann et al. 1978); one-dimensional consolidation settlement of normally consolidated and overconsolidated clay, using sublayers no thicker than 0.5 m; a time-settlement curve with user-selected drainage
Keep the source on GitHub with commits from every member and a README explaining how to run it
